items.title: AI is exposing the missing layer in strategic planning
items.summary: AI is making teams faster, but not organizations. The gap is a missing layer: governed work context that turns a change in strategy into a change in what happens next. AI is making teams faster but that doesn’t necessarily mean it is making organizations faster. That distinction matters.
